g.text: Objective: show how far the intrinsic value moves when one assumption, then two at once, is wrong.

text.tspan: axes: revenue_growth, operating_margin, tax_rate, sales_to_capital, terminal_growth, cost_of_equity, pretax_cost_of_debt

g.text: the company has an intrinsic value
the story margin check is done
the ticker cannot be valued (exit code 1)

text.tspan: the tornado bars, widest first, the five by five grid of margins of safety, and the scenario range, base first
each rate assumption is moved 1 percentage point (0.01) up and down, the sales-to-capital ratio × 0.8 and × 1.2, one at a time
the ratio is the axis sales_to_capital; every other axis is a rate
swing = |intrinsic value at the high end − intrinsic value at the low end|, bars ranked widest first
an end with g_terminal ≥ the weighted average cost of capital (WACC), a tax rate outside [0, 1) or a cost of capital ≤ 0: no value, ranked last
pretax_cost_of_debt is skipped with a WACC path; cost_of_equity shifts the whole path; tax_rate shifts tax_rate_path too
a five by five grid crosses the two widest axes
steps on a rate axis: −1%, −0.5%, 0%, +0.5%, +1% in absolute terms, that is percentage points, not relative
cell = intrinsic value ÷ price, the margin of safety; no price, or price ≤ 0: the intrinsic value
a cell with g_terminal ≥ the weighted average cost of capital (WACC): empty; a tax rate outside [0, 1) or a cost of capital ≤ 0 empties a cell only on an axis that cell moved
the scenario range is valued, base first [scenarios in the story file]
base first, then each scenario in file order, one plain discounted cash flow (DCF) each

g.text: no scenario range [no scenarios in the story file]
the ticker cannot be valued, exit code 1 [a scenario cannot be built, or its terminal growth reaches its weighted average cost of capital (WACC)]
story margin is green [company margin at most the sector's]
story margin is yellow [high-growth and company margin above the sector's]
story margin is unknown [a margin missing]
the bars, the grid and the scenario range go on to the narrative flags [always]
